name: Teaching Practicum in Value Education
description: Students are expected to assist with teaching that includes preparing course materials, managing class activities and examination, providing support to student engagement, grading assignments. They are also expected to help with practical, tutorials, class projects (depending on the course content). In addition, students are expected to assist the center in other administrative tasks, such as student mentorship, online communications, offering practical sessions for students.
